description: Finance content the xiaolin_finance plugin must not distill. Rules never delete a claim silently: each match produces an explicit risk_constraint that the quality gate can act on.

prohibited_categories.investment_advice: Direct instructions to buy or sell, or guaranteed-return claims.
prohibited_categories.market_prediction: Forecasts stated as certainty, including price prediction without basis.
prohibited_categories.emotional_language: Incitement, panic framing or exaggerated judgement.
prohibited_categories.unverified_fact: Unconfirmed figures or claims whose source cannot be identified.

rules.message: Direct investment instructions or guaranteed-return claims must not enter generated content.
Forecast language requires evidence, uncertainty, and explicit assumptions.
Incitement, panic framing or exaggerated judgement lowers explanation quality and must be down-ranked.
Unconfirmed figures or unattributable claims require a named source before they may be distilled.
